description: This Java source file defines a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS, demonstrating the implementation of a watch face with complications, background rendering, and time updates. It contains an inner Engine class that manages drawing, interactions, and complication handling.

classes.name: ComplicationSimpleWatchFaceService
classes.description: A subclass of CanvasWatchFaceService that provides a watch face with complications.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, responsible for drawing the watch face, handling complications, and managing updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face, background, complications, and style when the service is created.

methods.name: initializeBackground
methods.description: Loads and sets up the background bitmap and paint.

methods.name: initializeComplication
methods.description: Sets up data structures and styles for the complications.

methods.name: initializeWatchFace
methods.description: Configures paints, colors, and extracts palette colors from the background image.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface size changes, scales background, and sets up complication positioning.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Main drawing method that renders background, complications, and watch hands.

methods.name: drawBackground
methods.description: Renders the background image based on ambient mode.

methods.name: drawComplications
methods.description: Draws complication data text at designated positions.

methods.name: drawWatchFace
methods.description: Draws tick marks and watch hands according to current time.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Handles the time tick event to refresh the display.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts rendering for ambient and active modes.

methods.name: updateWatchHandStyle
methods.description: Adjusts paint styles based on ambient mode.

methods.name: onComplicationDataUpdate
methods.description: Updates internal data when complications provide new data.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, detecting taps on complications.

methods.name: getTappedComplicationId
methods.description: Determines if a tap is within a complication area.

methods.name: onComplicationTap
methods.description: Handles tap actions for complications, including launching activities or permissions.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the update handler based on visibility and mode.

methods.name: shouldTimerBeRunning
methods.description: Checks whether the timer should be running (visible and not in ambient).
